about_the_game:
Customize Your Mecha Squad: Select from a vast array of equipment offered by nine major manufacturers to outfit your mechas. Unlock powerful "Combo Skills" by combining specific items. For instance, pairing the "Freeze" Heavy Sword with the "T12" Propulsion Device triggers the "Greatsword Strike." Some equipment even unlock special forms, like long-range sniping or group suppression with the "H37" Transformable HMG.

Create Your Combat Strategy: Choose from dozens of module types, like Burning, Electric Bounce, Rupture, and Core Damage, to tailor your squad's playstyle. Equip modules in the Command Center to boost all mechas. If you’re lucky enough to obtain 'growth' modules in the early stage and equip them to the Command Center panel…

Engage in Dynamic Events and Combat Maps: Experience various events across different disaster stages, building your understanding of the pilots and uncovering the dark secrets behind the "Death Ring." Complete missions such as decapitation, evacuation, defense, and mining to earn rewards that can change the fate of cities.

Fight the Monster Horde: Face terrifying creatures like the vengeful "Acid Lizard," explosive "Poison Frog," and spiked "Shiver Princer." Utilize your mecha squad's combat advantages and plan strategies—raiding enemy backlines, causing chaos among elite monsters, and unleashing group bombardments—to succeed. Every choice could be the key to humanity’s survival.

name: Death Ring: Second Impact

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 4 Cores base 2.5GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVDIA GTX1660 or AMD RX 6500 XT
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 8 Cores base 3.0GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVDIA RTX2080 or RX 7600
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Death Ring: Second Impact is a turn-based Roguelite strategy game. As the commander of the "Griffin" squadron, you must lead your Mechas and Pilots to resist the threat of mutated monsters and approaching to the secrets hidden behind the Death Ring.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Traditional Chinese
